value.rationale: Uniform exact eigenvalue/multiplicity classification of an infinite natural two-parameter token graph family directly motivated by current spectral work; determines an unknown exact natural invariant (all Laplacian eigenvalues, multiplicities) and explicit nontrivial spanning-tree counts. The missing standard and incidence-kernel sectors are not implicit in a single spectral radius or generic cograph integrality. The \(m=2\), \(n=2\) rank boundaries and arbitrary imbalance are structural, and the result is neither a one-off parameter slice nor a tiny numerical gain.
